title: Machine learning approach yields epigenetic biomarkers of food allergy
author: Ayush Alag
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x7pfrmn

steps.title: Set up Eclipse Project and Dependencies
steps.instruction: Initialize the development environment and download required libraries.

substeps.instruction: Create an Eclipse project with the provided src files containing the Java code.
Download weka jar files from https://www.cs.waikato.ac.nz/ml/weka/downloading.html and place weka-src.jar and weka.jar into a directory named 'extjar'.
Download RBFNetwork.jar from https://jar-download.com/artifact-search/RBFNetwork and add it to the 'extjar' directory.
Download libsvm.jar from https://jar-download.com/download-handling.php.
Download data.jar and place it within the main project directory (ensure it contains input and output folders with subfolders).
Optional: Generate JavaDoc via Eclipse --> Project --> Generate JavaDoc.

steps.title: Validate CpG Input Data
steps.instruction: Verify the integrity and dimensions of the downloaded CpG datasets from GEO accession GSE59999.

substeps.instruction: Expand the data/input/gse59999 folder and verify the following files: allergy-59999-datasets.txt (215 MB, 30 rows x 405,659 columns), nonallergic-59999-datasets.txt (98.9 MB, 14 rows x 405,659 columns), and sensitized-59999-datasets.txt (215 MB, 30 rows x 405,659 columns).
Run the main program for com.allergezy.fa.util.FileUtil in Eclipse to validate row and column counts.

steps.title: Generate 8-Fold Cross-Validation Datasets
steps.instruction: Split the 58 samples into training, testing, and hidden datasets across eight random iterations.

substeps.instruction: Run the main method in com.allergezy.fa.kfold.KFoldDatasetGenerator to split samples into 40 training, 10 testing, and 8 hidden samples (balanced between food-allergic and food-sensitized).
Locate the final split file at data/input/gse59999/k401008/gse59999-kfold-cases-final.txt.
Run the main method for com.allergezy.fa.kfold.KFoldDatasetInfo to verify file access and sample distribution.

steps.title: Prioritize CpG Features using GEO2R
steps.instruction: Use the NCBI GEO2R tool to reduce the feature space from >400K to a prioritized list of differentially expressed CpGs.

substeps.instruction: For each of the eight independent cases, split the 40 training samples into two cohorts (allergic vs. sensitized).
Use GEO2R to derive eight lists of 100 CpGs each (one list per case).
Save the full signature to data/input/gse59999/geo2r/Geo2R-cpgs.txt.

steps.title: Map CpGs to Genes and Analyze Overlap
steps.instruction: Combine prioritized lists and map the unique CpGs to their corresponding genes.

substeps.instruction: Combine the eight lists to identify the 636 unique CpGs.
Run the main method in com.allergezy.fa.geo2r.CPGAnnotations to map CpGs to genes using the file data/input/gse59999/geo2r/Geo2r-gse5999-full-sign.txt.
Run the main method in com.allergezy.fa.geo2r.Geo2rCpgInfo to compute overlap between CpGs; results are saved in data/input/gse59999/geo2r/geo2RfeatureScoring.txt.

steps.title: Create ML-Ready Dataset Files
steps.instruction: Generate smaller dataset files containing only the 636 unique CpG values as columns.

substeps.instruction: Run com.allergezy.fa.dataset.DatasetCreatorForEachCase to generate eight files (case-0.txt through case-7.txt) in the input/gse59999/ml-data directory.

steps.title: Perform Single-Feature Scoring
steps.instruction: Evaluate the predictive accuracy of each individual CpG using four different ML models.

substeps.instruction: Run the main method com.allergezy.fa.feature.SingleFeatureScoringRunner to build Decision Trees (DT), Logistic Regression (LR), Radial Basis Function (RBF), and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP - 2 hidden layers, 10 nodes each) for each of the 636 CpGs across 8 cases.
Review results in data/output/singlefeature/kfoldresult (subdirectories case0-case7, further split by model type).
Run com.allergezy.fa.feature.BestFeatureIdentifierUsingHiddenTestScores to compute the average hidden test accuracy for each feature.
Locate the final sorted list in data/output/singlefeature/kfoldresult.bestFeatureScoresCpg.txt.

steps.title: Optimize Multi-Feature Combinations
steps.instruction: Iteratively combine the top-performing CpGs to increase classifier accuracy while avoiding overfitting.

substeps.instruction: Select the top 18 CpGs based on previous accuracy scores.
Use com.allergezy.fa.multifeature.casegenerator.MultiFeatureCasesGenerator to create combinations of 2, 3, up to 12 features (averaging 200 unique combinations per feature count).
Run the set of cases specified in data/output/multifeature/setup/summary.txt using com.allergezy.fa.kfold.verify.VerifyWekaDatasetRunner.
Apply a voting scheme (majority prediction) for odd numbers of models (1 to 101) to determine the final classification.
Iterate by adding one feature at a time and selecting the best models; results are stored in data/output/multfeature/result/Final.

steps.title: Perform Biological Enrichment and GO Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the final 13-gene signature to identify biological pathways and functions.

substeps.instruction: Import the 13-gene signature into Illumina’s BaseSpace Correlation Engine for biological enrichment.

Use the GO Enrichment Analysis Tool to find GO terms associated with the gene list (RNF213, SARS, ZNF252, TMED10P, ABCF2, TIMP2, MAFK, CD7, PANX1, CTBP2, SLC24A2, ARID5B, KIF13B, FAM190B) for biological process, molecular function, and cellular component.
Use the Princeton University Generic Gene Ontology (GO) Term Mapper (select 'HomoSapiens') to map annotations to higher-level terms.
Use REVIGO to cluster and visualize GO terms via the TreeMap tab and download the resulting CSV.
Visualize the network of terms using NaviGo (Open BP Visualizer).
